sentence: This project studies how the brain processes time when looking at images and how that relates to memory.
This project creates a center that gathers teaching resources for information technology.
This project researches ways to turn textile waste into fiber, yarn and finished goods.
This project studies how photosynthetic bacteria control their light-harvesting system by looking at how its proteins are put together.
This project creates a theory hub that works on big questions about quantum information and quantum systems.
This project builds computer models of proteins to find out how T cell receptors recognize peptide antigens.
This project studies how quantum dots combined with organic semiconductors behave when they are deformed.
This project runs a summer research program where teachers work on computer science topics such as machine learning and cybersecurity.
This project engineers particles from neutrophils to deliver toxic cargo to glioblastoma cells and tests how well they work.
This project turns security camera video into anonymous motion heatmaps that show how people move through public spaces.
This project tries to find out which maize genes control cell growth so plants can regenerate from genetically modified cells.
This project studies how chemical demulsifiers reduce oil fouling on membranes used to treat oily wastewater.
This project builds two mobile radars that scan clouds quickly to see how clouds and precipitation develop.
This project builds a system that finds the 3D shape and motion of objects in streaming video using only 2D annotations for training.
This project designs a vision system that combines nanophotonic metamaterials with image sensor circuits to run machine vision.
This project uses DNA sequencing to study how brown bear populations changed over time and how conservation actions affected them.
